dedupe_keys.name: hydraulic model hec ras of downstream of tuttle creek reservoir at the confluence of the big blue river and the kansas river near manhattan ks

description: A U.S. Army Engineer Research and Development Center team publishes a two-dimensional HEC-RAS model below Tuttle Creek Reservoir near Manhattan, Kansas. Zenodo lists geometry, plan, unsteady-flow and map files under CC0. The own page says the terrain uses USGS 3DEP elevations with field-sampled underwater cross-sections and calibration to measured water surface during collection. The configured hydraulic runs correspond to streamflows considered in a related ecological study. This model can test river-stage and floodplain-flow assumptions downstream of a reservoir. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these HEC-RAS project files. Coverage is the Kansas and Big Blue confluence reach and selected flows, not an operational flood forecast service. A limitation is that geometry and calibration are tied to the 2015 terrain and 2023 bathymetry; future morphology can change hydraulics. HEC-RAS software is a separate dependency. No model file was downloaded or simulation rerun.
